inspection_method: Independent cold inspection of each original through vision_analyze; parent ledger consulted only after all image inspections.
limitations: Static endpoint captures do not verify animation, collisions, hinge axes, hidden attachment surfaces or mesh topology.
Marketing is promotional imagery, not exact geometry or an open-interior reference.
Small hardware and secondary mobile text limit inspection; no physical-device or accessibility compliance claim.
No art edits, screenshot replacements, ledger changes, kanban transitions or final user approval.

observations.desktop_closed: Pale layered chest, flat-topped mountain, rounded green vegetation, brass clasp/disc/side ring/corner caps and rough gray feet are intact-looking and fully framed.
observations.desktop_open: Raised plain inner lid, pale cavity, green rim and two rear hinge fittings visible; full lid tab and feet remain in frame.
observations.mobile_closed: Identity and controls retained without cropping; green seam and chunky latch can read as loose closure at this scale.
observations.mobile_open: Complete object and controls visible; pale cavity has weak depth shading and rear hinge contacts are small and ambiguous.
observations.marketing: Same ivory mountain chest, green vegetation and recessed seam, brass fittings and irregular gray feet. The seam already exists in the reference.

finish_differences: Viewer has stronger regular horizontal bands and angular mountain facets; marketing shading and vegetation read softer.
Mobile closure, stepped rim corners and hinge continuity are readability concerns, not established detachment or failed closure. The green reference seam prevents treating the band alone as a fault.
entries.decision_reason: Broad identity and framing retained; no unequivocal geometry defect established across the originals.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Parent pass is consistent with cold findings; no approval inferred.

observations.desktop_closed: Red plank chest, cream alternating joints, blue floral lid panel, brass hardware and dark feet are fully visible.
observations.desktop_open: Plain red inner lid, pale wood cavity and two rear hinge fittings visible. Projecting free-edge tab is consistent with opened clasp.
observations.mobile_closed: Whole chest and controls fit; small foreshortened floral relief has reduced legibility.
observations.mobile_open: Open cavity, lid tab and feet fit; small hinge attachments cannot be mechanically resolved.
observations.marketing: Coral-red chest with cream joints, blue panel bearing cream floral stems and coral centers, brass caps/clasp/disc/ring and dark block feet.

finish_differences: Viewer wood and brass appear more uniform; floral detail is less legible at mobile scale than in marketing.
Decorated outer lid is visible when closed; its absence from the open inner face is expected occlusion, not missing ornament.
Dark closed seam and open hinge clearance do not alone prove a closure or attachment fault.
entries.decision_reason: Motif, hardware identity and complete framing retained without demonstrated structural defect.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Parent pass agrees with cold inspection; no approval inferred.

observations.desktop_closed: Banded tan chest carries two tall capped towers, two short cylinders and connecting walls; brass fittings and rough rounded feet visible without clipping.
observations.desktop_open: Plain banded inner lid and empty tan cavity visible, with two rear hinge pieces and projecting free-edge clasp tab; full silhouette framed.
observations.mobile_closed: Tower silhouette, clasp and controls remain readable and unclipped.
observations.mobile_open: Complete raised lid, cavity and feet remain within viewer; hinge attachment and rear corner joins are difficult to resolve.
observations.marketing: Pale pink-beige chest, same four-tower composition and ivory conical caps, brass hardware, dark seam and irregular rounded feet.

finish_differences: Viewer regular horizontal banding reads wood-like rather than natural earth; the marketing reference is also wood-like.
Rough feet contrast with smooth body and tower surfaces; this is finish contrast rather than broken supports.
Dark hinge clearance gives a loose-lid impression but does not prove disconnection.
entries.decision_reason: Distinctive architecture and hardware retained; no demonstrated clipping or geometry failure.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Parent pass agrees with cold inspection; no approval inferred.

observations.desktop_closed: Dark green chest with red-orange/yellow flowers, green foliage, gold borders and brass fittings; rounded top relief and angular front/side vines visible.
observations.desktop_open: Plain dark inner lid, dark cavity and rear brass hinges visible; complete silhouette including tab and feet fits.
observations.mobile_closed: Floral identity and control layout preserved without clipping; hardware detail and dark feet have limited contrast.
observations.mobile_open: Open lid and cavity are clear in silhouette, but deep interior surfaces and hinge attachment are difficult to inspect.
observations.marketing: Forest-green textured chest with rounded coral/salmon lid flowers, angular front/side vines, fine gold borders, brass clasp/disc/ring/caps and square feet.

finish_differences: Viewer lacquer reads flatter and darker than promotional surface; brass is less reflective.
Low interior contrast limits depth inspection but does not demonstrate a missing floor or mesh hole.
Rounded top flowers versus angular side ornament are present in both source and captures, not a newly introduced mismatch.
entries.decision_reason: Broad floral identity and framing retained; finish/readability limitations do not establish structural failure.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Parent pass agrees with cold inspection; no approval inferred.

observations.desktop_closed: Warm mottled chest, green-topped tepui, thin pale cascade and oval pool, brass fittings and block feet preserve identity; fully framed.
observations.desktop_open: Raised mottled inner lid and cavity visible. Two rear hinge forms are separate from the projecting free-edge front clasp; their attachment interfaces are unresolved.
observations.mobile_closed: Whole motif, feet and controls fit. Waterfall reads as a thin white strip and pool as a flat oval.
observations.mobile_open: Open state and complete silhouette clear; small hinges and low surface separation create a slightly suspended-lid impression without proving detachment.
observations.marketing: Same salmon/terracotta mottling, green plateau, white waterfall/pool, brass hardware, block feet and pronounced dark closed seam.

finish_differences: Viewer mottling is soft and relatively uniform; plateau and box have limited material separation.
Schematic white waterfall and pool are shared with the source, not evidence of missing geometry.
Dark closed seam also exists in marketing; open hinge clearance alone cannot establish a broken hinge.
entries.decision_reason: Preserve the existing rear-hinge readability decision hold despite no unequivocal geometry defect. User/parent resolution is still required; do not treat the released front clasp as a broken rear hinge.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Read after cold inspection: parent status needs-decision retains targeted rear-hinge review. Parent recorded runtime follow-up pass does not prove hidden contacts or physical clearances and does not remove this hold. That runtime was not independently exercised here.
